questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

About half _________ hour later, I saw _________ old lady walking towards my house.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**an ; an**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The indefinite article "**an**" is used before words that begin with a vowel sound. In this case, "**hour**" begins with a silent "h" and is pronounced with a vowel sound, so "**an**" is correct.
 
• Similarly, "**an**" is also used before "**old lady**" because "old" begins with a vowel sound.
 
• **Options 1, 3, and 4** are incorrect because they do not follow the rule for using "**an**" with vowel sounds.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"About half **an**__ hour later, I saw __**an**__ old lady walking towards my house."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "a ; an"** is incorrect because "**a**" cannot precede "**hour**" due to its vowel sound.
 
• **Option 3: "an ; a"** is incorrect because "**a**" cannot precede "**old lady**" as it begins with a vowel sound.
 
• **Option 4: "a ; the"** is incorrect because the definite article "**the**" is unnecessary here; "**an**" is required.

questions.question:
**A sentence has been given in Active/Passive Voice. Out of the four alternatives suggested, select the one which best expresses the same sentence in Passive/Active Voice. **

The labourers were digging a canal.

options.text: A canal is being digging by the labourers
A canal was dug by the labourers
A canal was being dug by the labourers
A canal had been dug by the labourers

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "The labourers were digging a canal."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "a canal" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "were digging" to "was being dug" (past continuous passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "the labourers."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"A canal was being dug by the labourers."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"A canal is being digging by the labourers." – Incorrect grammar (present continuous instead of past continuous and incorrect verb form).
 
• **Option 2: **"A canal was dug by the labourers." – Incorrect tense (simple past instead of past continuous).
 
• **Option 4: **"A canal had been dug by the labourers." – Incorrect tense (past perfect instead of past continuous).

• The word **"martinet"** refers to someone who is a strict disciplinarian, particularly in enforcing rules and regulations. (अनुशासनप्रिय व्यक्ति)

 

 
• **Example:** The new headmaster was a martinet who insisted on punctuality and adherence to the school rules.

 

 

 
• **Strict disciplinarian** means someone who firmly enforces discipline and rules without compromise. (सख्त अनुशासनकर्ता)

 

 
• **Example:** The military officer was a strict disciplinarian who demanded order and precision from his soldiers.

 

 

 
• Hence, we can conclude that the meaning of **"martinet"** aligns with **"strict disciplinarian"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Strict disciplinarian**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Candidate** (उम्मीदवार): A person who is considered for a position, award, or election.

 

 
• **Example:** She is a strong candidate for the position of team leader.

 

 

 
• **Supervisor** (पर्यवेक्षक): A person who oversees the work of others to ensure it is done correctly.

 

 
• **Example:** The supervisor ensured that the employees adhered to the company’s safety guidelines.

 

 

 
• **Military leader** (सैनिक नेता): A person who commands and leads a group or unit in the military.

 

 
• **Example:** The military leader was known for his strategic brilliance in battle.

questions.question: According to the author, how can the matter be resolved?

options.text: By the experience of the people

• He gives the example of **Aristotle**, who could have avoided his mistake by simply checking the fact himself.

• Thus, according to the author, matters should be resolved by **observing yourself**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Relevant Line from the Passage:** *“If the matter is one that can be settled by observation, make the observation yourself.”*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Option 3:** Reading books is not suggested as the primary method for resolving factual matters.
 
• **Option 4:** The author criticizes dogmatic statements made without personal evidence or observation.
